name: batch-05
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A flattened round deep blue glass bead hangs from a small brass-colored top loop; its face has concentric ivory-white, light cyan and dark navy eye circles. Keep the four nested color fields and simple circular silhouette, without extra charms or script.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A tan wooden blunt-ended decorative arrow lies diagonally upward to the right, with large angular cream feather pieces, a short red tie and one small golden metal bell. Preserve the prepared arrow's soft blunt shaft and simple feather silhouette; no sharp arrowhead or added labels.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A shallow reddish-brown wooden fruit tray holds green bananas, one round yellow-green pomelo, an orange, a green apple and a golden pear with a short brown stem. Preserve the five distinct fruit types and low spread arrangement, without added flowers, labels or offerings.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A jade-green curved ruyi scepter with a broad softly scalloped cloud-shaped head rests horizontally on a small two-support brown wooden stand. Preserve the asymmetrical curved handle and distinct head, without inscriptions, tassels or added symbols.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A tan bamboo-colored decorative rake fans into seven slender curved claws above a narrow handle and broad brown wooden foot, with three plain golden oval paper ornaments on the front. Preserve seven claws and three unlettered ovals; no coins, masks or extra emblems.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: One smooth lacquer-red curved horn charm with a pointed curling tip is shown beside a small open cream gift box with tan edges. Preserve the simple solid horn silhouette and unlettered box, without a crown, face, beads or metal cap.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: One shallow pale tan tray carries four round green grapes arranged in two rows of two, with slightly lighter lower grapes. Preserve this single four-grape tray from the existing icon, without stems, leaves, clock faces or extra fruit.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: One thick muted gray-green iron horseshoe faces upward in a broad U shape, with four small pale nail holes in two vertical pairs. Preserve the open upper ends and four holes, without nails, engraving or decorative charms.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A simple brown wooden doorway with a sliding cross-barred panel stands behind a small square tan wooden bean box, with three golden roasted soybeans visible around its open top. Keep the wooden structure and loose beans, without masks, figures or added writing.
